name: VESA monitor arm
summary: A monitor arm lets you set screen height and distance precisely, frees desk space for mouse movement and helps you keep a comfortable posture.
lookFor: A weight and size rating that matches your monitor, with a VESA mount pattern your monitor supports
Full range of height and tilt, and tension that holds the screen without drifting
Clamp or grommet mounting that suits your desk thickness and material
suitableFor: Players whose monitor stand takes up desk space or sits too low or high, and anyone using a lower sensitivity who needs mouse room.
cons: Requires a compatible monitor and desk
Cheap arms can sag over time
